Slow coherent upward drift (~0.7 °C over 20 min) with stable overhead temps ~72.6 °C; column otherwise steady
Intermittent jumps to 3.6-3.9 while FT703/FT704 stay ~0.153/0.36 (ratio ~2.7), inconsistent computed ratio
Pressure ~749 mbar and dPs steady, no blockage or leak signature
